svg.title: Build the Pipeline Around Verified Milestones
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-repeatable-recovery-milestones; chapter number: 12; title: Build the Pipeline Around Verified Milestones; subtitle: Choose a market, verify the opportunity, prepare the conversation, and maintain a documented handoff.; caption: Eric Richardson of Money Making Juggernaut, Spencer Vann, Surplus Funds List, and Surplus Systems emphasize repeatable execution, follow-up, case status, and operating references.; assumptions note: The weekly cadence is a planning framework, not a four-week completion or payout schedule reported by these practitioners. Advance only when each verification gate is satisfied.; note: Richardson cautions against leaving employment before the pipeline can support delayed payments. Full Circle on Surplus Funds Secrets checks client information before a paid attorney handoff because a bad case can still incur the retainer.; chart type: timeline_roadmap; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Commit to a market and process; deliverable: A selected market and a repeatable operating reference, following Vann's focus guidance and Surplus Systems' master-SOP approach.; gate: Avoid repeated niche switching before completing deals; Vann describes that pattern as a source of lost months.; week: Week 2; title: Qualify the recovery opportunity; deliverable: A researched case with actual debt checked and questions about second mortgages and liens addressed, following Richardson.; gate: Do not equate the opening bid with everything owed or proceed on an apparent surplus that has not been verified.; week: Week 3; title: Practice contact and maintain follow-up; deliverable: Call practice using recorded wins and losses, following Jordan Tejeda Marketing, with outreach and next actions tracked through the Surplus Funds List CRM approach.; gate: Keep replies actionable and claimant status current. Richardson describes prompt calls after reply alerts; Surplus Funds List maintains claimant portal status.; week: Week 4; title: Verify the handoff and track progress; deliverable: Checked client information, an applicable processing handoff, and ongoing tasks and claimant updates, following Full Circle and Surplus Funds List.; gate: Check the case before incurring an attorney retainer. Maintain follow-up rather than treating a signed agreement as a completed recovery.
